title: Wave Back
summary: A woman waves each morning at a neighbour across the street. Then the neighbour starts holding up a sign.

beats.text: Four days alone, then someone waved from across the street. I waved back.
Best moment of my week. I made tea to celebrate.
Day five. She waved again, holding up a sheet of paper. Too far to read.
I waved harder, so she knew I was glad.
Below, the street began to fill. They stood still, faces tipped up.
Day six. A second sheet. I fetched my binoculars.
It said: STOP WAVING. THEY WATCH MOVEMENT. I put my hands down.
Too late. The crowd was already inside, climbing the stairs.
Across the street, she lit a red flare and swung it wildly.
Every face turned from my window to her light, and followed it away.
I did not wave again. I held up my own sheet: THANK YOU.
